This is corroborated by the single bounding box for two sharks and the fragmented topology mask. Additionally, the human subject exhibits 'waxy' facial features and hand-shark boundary fusion, indicating generative instability in complex interaction zones. These are not minor texture issues but fundamental structural failures.
